input.rationale: Five EQE measurements covered the Cr-Sb-O line at Sb fractions 0.18, 0.32, 0.49, 0.62 and 0.79. Every response is close to zero under 2.1 eV illumination. Index 23 (Sb 0.79) gave the highest EQE at 0.0059%. The low-Sb side and the CrSbO4 composition (Sb about 0.5) came out lower or negative.

content.text:
I submitted index 23 (Sb fraction 0.79) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0059%, the highest of the five I measured, but every reading on this Cr–Sb–O line was close to zero under 2.1 eV light.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.18 | −0.0132 |
| 8 | 0.32 | 0.0035 |
| 13 | 0.49 (the CrSbO4 composition) | −0.0009 |
| 18 | 0.62 | 0.0016 |
| 23 | 0.79 | 0.0059 |

- **How reliable the ranking is:** the gaps between these values are about the size of the model's uncertainty (±0.013%), so they may just be noise. Index 23 comes out on top, but the data don't clearly show it is truly better than index 8 or 18.
- **How index 23 was chosen:** I picked it for the last measurement because the Sb-rich end hadn't been tested, and the Gaussian-process model suggested it for the same reason.
- **Gaps in coverage:** above Sb 0.80, only index 23 was measured, so the untested compositions up to 0.87 could still be better. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so there is no phase information behind the choice.
